I'm at the school store when my
attention is
caught by an Umamusume
standing in front of a
shelf.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Rice recommended I try
the
special carrot buns from the school
store.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
She requested my review of the product,
so I
came to purchase the product in
order to
complete this task. However...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The commodity in question is completely
sold
out. It seems I failed to conduct
enough prior
research on this bread.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When I inquired with a store employee
about the item, I was informed that it is
a very popular
product that regularly
sells out quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In addition, I was able to verify the date
of the next shipment. The problem now
is formulating a
strategy for when the
time comes...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Procuring the item at the time of the
store's
opening is indeed most simple
and logical.
Analyzing potential.

text_block_list.text:
Comparing my schedule and time of
shipment...
Comparison complete. I will
be available to wait
in line at that time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your wise words of advice are much
appreciated.
I believe this operation
shall prove successful.

text_block_list.text:

success with
my current capabilities.
